value: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ (Kōdo Giasu: Hangyaku no Rurūshu)
text: The Japanese title is コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ, read Kōdo Giasu: Hangyaku no Rurūshu, and it means Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion.
excerpt: Japanese title: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ

text: The anime was made at the studio Sunrise.
excerpt: Studio: Sunrise

text: Gorō Taniguchi directed the Code Geass anime.
excerpt: Director: Gorō Taniguchi

text: Ichirō Ōkouchi handled the series composition of the anime.
excerpt: Series Composition: Ichirō Ōkouchi

text: The original character designs come from the manga group Clamp.
excerpt: Character original design: CLAMP

text: Code Geass was the first anime series for which Clamp had ever been asked to design the characters.
excerpt: the first time Clamp had ever been requested to design the characters of an anime series

text: Kōtarō Nakagawa and Hitomi Kuroishi composed the music of the anime.
excerpt: Music: Kōtarō Nakagawa and Hitomi Kuroishi

text: The idea took shape at Sunrise, where Ichirō Ōkouchi and Gorō Taniguchi pitched it to the producer Yoshitaka Kawaguchi.
excerpt: began as a concept developed at Sunrise by Ichirō Ōkouchi and Gorō Taniguchi, who proposed it to producer Yoshitaka Kawaguchi

text: Its name may be taken from old Irish and Welsh stories about a geas, also spelled geis.
excerpt: The concept for the Geass may have been inspired by the Irish and Welsh legends of 'Geas' or 'Geis'

text: The first season, Lelouch of the Rebellion, has 25 episodes and aired from October 2006 to July 2007.

text: The second season, called R2, has 25 episodes and aired from April to September 2008.
excerpt: No. of episodes 25 Release Original network JNN ( MBS , TBS ) Original release April 6

text: Both seasons together add up to 50 television episodes.
excerpt: Season 1 ... 25 episodes; Season 2 ... 25 episodes

text: The film Lelouch of the Re;surrection opened in Japanese cinemas on February 9, 2019.

value: Set a year after the Zero Requiem

excerpt: A year has passed since the events of the "Zero Requiem", a scheme Emperor Lelouch vi Britannia formulated to end conflict with his death

text: The Akito the Exiled OVA series started in August 2012.
excerpt: August 4, 2012 to February 6, 2016

text: Rozé of the Recapture is a film series in four parts.
excerpt: Four-part film series

text: The Holy Britannian Empire has conquered Japan and renamed it Area 11.
excerpt: Holy Britannian Empire conquers Japan (renamed "Area 11")

excerpt: Geass is the "Power of Kings" granting "absolute obedience"

text: The English dub was shown in the United States on Adult Swim.

excerpt: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion Lost Colors, developed for the PlayStation Portable and PlayStation 2

value: Lelouch Lamperouge (ルルーシュ・ランペルージ)
text: Lelouch Lamperouge, also Lelouch vi Britannia, is written ルルーシュ・ランペルージ in Japanese and leads the rebellion as Zero.
excerpt: Seeking to build a peaceful world for his sister

text: Suzaku Kururugi is written 枢木スザク in Japanese and is the childhood friend of Lelouch.
excerpt: Claims to support reformism and that achieving results by wrong methods is meaningless

text: C.C. is written シー・ツー in Japanese and is the immortal witch who grants Geass.
excerpt: bestows the power of Geass upon Lelouch

value: Kallen Stadtfeld (カレン・シュタットフェルト)
text: Kallen Stadtfeld, who is also Kallen Kouzuki, is written カレン・シュタットフェルト in Japanese and belongs to the Black Knights.
excerpt: Her devotion to Zero is unmatched among any of the other members

value: Nunnally Lamperouge (ナナリー・ランペルージ)
text: Nunnally Lamperouge, also Nunnally vi Britannia, is written ナナリー・ランペルージ in Japanese and is the younger sister of Lelouch.
excerpt: All she wants is to be with him

value: Shirley Fenette (シャーリー・フェネット)
text: Shirley Fenette is written シャーリー・フェネット in Japanese and is a student at Ashford Academy.
excerpt: She jealously believes that he and Kallen are romantically linked

value: Milly Ashford (ミレイ・アッシュフォード)
text: Milly Ashford is written ミレイ・アッシュフォード in Japanese and is the Student Council president at Ashford Academy.
excerpt: President of the Student Council. Milly enjoys teasing Shirley

value: Rivalz Cardemonde (リヴァル・カルデモンド)
text: Rivalz Cardemonde is written リヴァル・カルデモンド in Japanese and is a student at Ashford Academy.
excerpt: Usually driving Lelouch around on his motorbike as an ante

value: Nina Einstein (ニーナ・アインシュタイン)
text: Nina Einstein is written ニーナ・アインシュタイン in Japanese and is a science student at Ashford Academy.
excerpt: She develops a deep lesbian obsession with Third Princess Euphemia

value: Euphemia li Britannia (ユーフェミア・リ・ブリタニア)
text: Euphemia li Britannia is written ユーフェミア・リ・ブリタニア in Japanese and is a princess of the imperial family.
excerpt: Pacifist and in many ways Suzaku's female counterpart

value: Cornelia li Britannia (コーネリア・リ・ブリタニア)
text: Cornelia li Britannia is written コーネリア・リ・ブリタニア in Japanese and is a princess of the imperial family.
excerpt: Extremely skilled in Knightmare Frame combat

value: Schneizel el Britannia (シュナイゼル・エル・ブリタニア)
text: Schneizel el Britannia is written シュナイゼル・エル・ブリタニア in Japanese and is a prince of the imperial family.
excerpt: Strategist on par with Lelouch

value: Charles zi Britannia (シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア)
text: Charles zi Britannia is written シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア in Japanese and is the Emperor of Britannia.
excerpt: Social Darwinism proponent; has 108 different consorts

value: Jeremiah Gottwald (ジェレミア・ゴットワルド)
text: Jeremiah Gottwald is written ジェレミア・ゴットワルド in Japanese and is an officer of the Britannian Army.
excerpt: Regular foot soldier (after Lelouch's Geass compulsion)

value: Rolo Lamperouge (ロロ・ランペルージ)
text: Rolo Lamperouge is written ロロ・ランペルージ in Japanese and lives with Lelouch and Nunnally.
excerpt: Assassin posing as Lelouch's brother

value: Lloyd Asplund (ロイド・アスプルンド)
text: Lloyd Asplund is written ロイド・アスプルンド in Japanese and is a scientist of the Britannian Army.
excerpt: Scientist, Knightmare developer; interested in Nina's personal research

text: Kaguya Sumeragi is written 皇神楽耶 in Japanese and is the head of the Kyōto House.
excerpt: Claims to be his future wife in the second season

text: Kyoshiro Tohdoh is written 藤堂鏡志朗 in Japanese and is the head of military operations of the Black Knights.
excerpt: Earned the nickname for his singular defeat of Holy Britannia

value: Diethard Ried (ディートハルト・リート)
text: Diethard Ried is written ディートハルト・リート in Japanese and is the head of information and public relations of the Black Knights.
excerpt: Rather have watched Zero topple Britannia

value: Bismarck Waldstein (ビスマルク・ヴァルトシュタイン)
text: Bismarck Waldstein is written ビスマルク・ヴァルトシュタイン in Japanese and is the Knight of One of the Knights of the Round.
excerpt: Strongest amongst the Knights of the Round

text: Lelouch's Geass allows him to order any person to obey the next thing he says.
excerpt: allows him to command any person to follow his subsequent order

text: In the later story, Lelouch pilots a Knightmare Frame named Shinkirō.
excerpt: Knightmare: Shinkirō

text: Suzaku becomes the Knight of Seven among the Knights of the Round.
excerpt: Britannian Army, Knights of the Round (Knight of Seven)

text: Suzaku pilots the Knightmare Frame called Lancelot.
excerpt: Knightmare: Lancelot, Lancelot Albion

text: C.C. is the one who gives the power of Geass to others, Lelouch among them.
excerpt: Grants Geass to others; bestows the power of Geass upon Lelouch

text: Kallen pilots the Knightmare Frame named Guren.
excerpt: Knightmare: Guren, Guren Mk-II

text: Nunnally is blind and uses a wheelchair.
excerpt: Condition: Blind and wheelchair-bound

text: Nina invents a powerful weapon known as the F.L.E.I.J.A. bomb.
excerpt: Creation: F.L.E.I.J.A. bomb

text: Euphemia holds the post of Sub-Viceroy of Area 11.
excerpt: Title: Sub-Viceroy of Area 11

text: Cornelia is the Viceroy of Area 11 and also the Commander-in-Chief.
excerpt: Title: Viceroy of Area 11

text: Schneizel is the only person whom Lelouch could not defeat in a game of chess.
excerpt: Only person whom Lelouch was unable to beat in chess

text: Charles is the 98th emperor of Britannia and has 108 consorts.
excerpt: Role: 98th Emperor; Has 108 different consorts

value: Geass Canceler (nullifies the effects of a Geass)
text: Jeremiah's Geass Canceler nullifies the effects that another Geass has had on a person.
excerpt: The latter also comes with the Geass Canceler, a blue, inverted form of the Geass with about the same capabilities as Rolo's Geass that nullifies any effects done onto a person by the Geass

text: Rolo's Geass lets him freeze time for a short while.
excerpt: Geass: Time freezing - allows him to temporarily freeze subjective time

text: Lloyd is the scientist who created the Lancelot frame.
excerpt: Creation: Lancelot Frame

text: Kaguya becomes chair of the supreme council of the UFN.
excerpt: Position: UFN Supreme Council Chairwoman

text: Tohdoh has the nickname Tohdoh of Miracles.
excerpt: Title: "Tohdoh of Miracles"

excerpt: Background: Former Hi-TV producer

excerpt: Geass: Precognition - allows him to see a few seconds into the future

text: Milly is the president of the Student Council.
excerpt: Role: Student Council President

text: Shirley is a member of the swimming team and of the Student Council.
excerpt: Role: Ashford student, swimmer

excerpt: Usually driving Lelouch around on his motorbike
